methodologyNotes: Covers benchtop and portable ('lunchbox') electric thickness planers for wood, sold at a published US MSRP or typical street price in USD. Excludes handheld electric planers, floor-standing/stationary industrial planers wider than 15 in, jointer-planer combination machines, and manual bench planes. Price is US MSRP/typical, USD. maxWidthInches is the maximum stock width the cutterhead can surface in a single pass, in inches. maxThicknessInches is the maximum stock thickness (height) that fits under the cutterhead, in inches. maxDepthOfCutInches is the maximum material removed in one pass at full width, in inches. cutterheadType is an enum: 'straight-knife' (disposable/reversible HSS blades), 'helical' (staggered rows of square carbide inserts), or 'spiral' (inline/spiral rows of inserts). cutterheadSpeedRpm is the no-load cutterhead rotational speed in RPM. feedRateFpm is the automatic stock feed rate in feet per minute; where two feed speeds exist the range is given (roughing to finishing). feedSpeeds is the count of selectable feed speeds (1 or 2). motorAmps is the rated motor current draw at 120 V, in amperes. dustPortDiameterInches is the dust-collection port outer diameter in inches; where two ports ship, both are listed. weightPounds is the bare-tool weight in pounds.
